arms.name: transcript-grow
arms.policy: whole history replayed; FIFO truncation from the front at the 64,000-token cap; fails at the 131,072 window (22,594 + 60*1,883 = 135,600)

arms.name: transcript-compact
arms.policy: state update at the wall: ~700-token digest replaces older turns at 64k, recent 4 turns raw, appends between walls

arms.name: pointer-stable
arms.policy: frozen index prefix byte-identical, fetched body appended in the suffix, next body prefetched in the same request; no rewrite lands in the reused prefix
arms.is_redesign_of: R arm (C0-EQUALINFO) that was 0.602 s vs 0.182 s

arms.name: lease-reopen
arms.policy: close at the wall and reopen a fresh session carrying only pointers plus a distilled state line (<=400 tok); reopens at turns 23 and 56

budget_derivation: 4 arms x 60 turns x 2 reps = 480; + 4 compaction digests (B, 2 per run); + 4 controls; + 12 repair attempts (3-attempt cap, band 24-27, 2 reps) = 500. 3 reps would be 720 and break the cap.

predictions.claim: pointer-stable p95 TTFT <= 0.5x transcript-grow at N=60
predictions.mechanism: A truncates every turn after 23 and re-prefills 40-64k; C's index+bodies are frozen from turn 12 and each turn pays only the ~700-token tail
predictions.falsified_if: C/A >= 0.5, or C's cached share after turn 12 < 0.80

predictions.claim: transcript-grow tokens-to-verified-success >= 1.5x pointer-stable, and the excess is repair turns, not per-turn cost
predictions.mechanism: truncation destroys the turn-2 k04 fact and the k01 source, so A burns 3-attempt repairs at 64k scale; C repairs in one resolve
predictions.falsified_if: A repair_turns <= C's, or A's non-repair per-turn uncached (within 1.2x of C's) explains the gap

predictions.claim: lease-reopen has the lowest p95 TTFT but loses checkpoint accuracy at t30/t60 unless the <=400-token state line carries the turn-2 fact and the turn-24 correction
predictions.mechanism: lease close discards anything not distilled; cold prefill of a ~2.5k prompt is cheap (208.7 ms at 1,024 tok, C27) but only what the state line names survives

predictions.claim: transcript-compact lands within 2x of pointer-stable on p95 but fails t30 where its digest dropped the turn-2 code
predictions.mechanism: a digest is lossy exactly where the fact is incidental; between walls B is cheap
predictions.falsified_if: B ties C's accuracy at lower total tokens

falsifier: If pointer-stable is not faster at p95 than transcript-grow AND does not solve with fewer total tokens, the 'use the space better' thesis fails on this hardware and LONGRUN-PREREG.md section 4 says so. Secondary narrowing: if lease-reopen wins p95 and ties accuracy, the win belongs to scoped reopening, not the frozen prefix; if transcript-compact ties accuracy at fewer tokens, compaction is sufficient.

metrics.definition: dispatch to first content token, streaming; ttft_server_s alongside; p50/p95 pooled per arm
sum(uncached prompt + completion) from turn 1 until the t60 checkpoint verifies, repairs included
turns after a failed verification, capped at 3 per checkpoint
exact match on t10 / t30 / t60, per checkpoint and pooled
cached / prompt_tokens per request; null means 0 per LIVE-CELLS-2 usage_note
item bodies the prompt can actually resolve this turn
turns dropped from the prompt this turn (A truncation, B compaction, D close)
turn index where each surviving checkpoint fact was stated

controls.must: resend turn 12's exact prompt: cached >= 0.95x prompt
controls.red_if: cached < 0.90 (counter is not measuring reuse; batch void)

controls.must: a 23k prompt never sent before: cached = 0
controls.red_if: cached > 64 (host hash mistaken for server reuse)

controls.control: mismatched tokenizer must show no reuse
controls.must: same body behind a different leading template: cached <= 64, on :8012 only (vLLM reports 0/45 cache counters)
checkpoint answered from the last 200 tokens: repair_turns 0, uncached <= residue + 700
controls.red_if: pays a re-prefill >= 5% of the prompt (wall accounting wrong)

assumptions: The 64,000-token cap is a design choice (half of occamy's 131,072 window), not a measured wall; a different cap moves turn 23 and re-parameterises every prediction.
C's prefetch is expressible in one request on occamy's native tool-call fetch; vLLM's text FETCH protocol is not used in this design.
N=60 with 2 reps is chosen over N=60 with 3 reps (720 requests) and over N=100 (4 arms x 100 x 2 = 800) purely to respect the <=500 cap.
Checkpoint questions are the turn's own instruction, so they cost no extra request; a checkpoint scored from a separate request would add 3 per run per arm.
